newsTranslation.description: Machine translation of one news item into the other site language. Shown only while sourceHash matches the item (shared/news-translation-hash.mjs).

sourceLanguage.description: Language of the news item as published.

lead.description: Translation of the lead: summaryMarkup without the title prefix. Entity tags are kept byte for byte, including their Dutch inner text. Null when the item has no lead.

sourceHash.description: First 12 hex characters of sha256(title + "\n" + (summaryMarkup ?? "")) at translation time.

engine.description: Model that wrote the translation, for example claude-opus-5-5, deepseek-v4.1-flash or claude-haiku-4-5.

method.description: How the translation was produced: in a reviewed Claude Code session, or by the pipeline through OpenCode Zen, the DeepSeek API or the Anthropic Messages API.
